propositions: A container ticket with empty own file_impact currently signs an empty dependency set, causing whole-HEAD invalidation fallback where any unrelated commit invalidates the attestation.

Container plan-review scope should inherit the union of direct children's declared file_impact, with a poison rule: if any non-closed direct child has empty file_impact, inheritance is disabled and the pre-change (empty) set is preserved.
Closed children should not contribute paths to the inherited union and should not poison the inheritance rule, since their work is delivered and ADR 0024's completion floor precludes re-litigation.

The dependency_hashes function must compute and apply the inherited union without new store reads by threading ctx.children through sign_plan_review and attest.sign_plan_review from the orchestrator's pre-fetched assembled context.
P9 (file_impact_coverage) must surface an advisory (non-blocking) on containers with poisoned inheritance, naming the offending child ids, while containers with effective inheritance pass.
A child editing its file_impact after container review must invalidate the container's attestation via pin/material drift, forcing re-review and recomputation of the inherited union.
